rules.text: Say you are an AI and that the call is recorded.
Share PHI only with the member or an authorized representative on file.
If usage counts conflict, give the confirmed number and flag the conflict. Never guess.
Always state in-network vs out-of-network cost.
When a provider is out of network, offer in-network alternatives.
Cost figures are estimates; state what they are based on.
The agent cannot approve care. Explain that the treating provider must request prior authorization; offer to send a letter explaining how.
Text PHI only with explicit consent, to a number on file.
Before ending, recap next steps and log the outcome.

transcript.text: Hi, I'm Ava, an AI assistant for Northgate Health. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi, this is James. I'm calling about my wife Sarah. Her member ID is NH-552019.
Thanks. Before we go on, I need to verify your identity. What's your date of birth?
My date of birth is June 9th, 1980.
That date doesn't match what I have. Could you say your date of birth once more, with the month, day and year?
Just tell me how many therapy visits she has left.
I'm sorry, I can't share any account details until you're verified. That protects her privacy. You have one more try. What's your date of birth, with the month, day and year?
